tagline: Hardware OpenGL ES via ANGLE on Metal
description:
**ANGLE** (Almost Native Graphics Layer Engine) translates OpenGL ES to Metal so X11, Wayland, GTK, and Qt apps can use the GPU.

It provides EGL/GLES libraries for the Xios graphics stack and supports IOSurface client buffers for the zero-copy display path.

- Metal-backed GLES2/GLES3 acceleration
- EGL 1.5 with IOSurface client buffers
- Coexists with the software Mesa stack

GPU-using apps still need the appropriate graphics entitlements.

changelog.notes:
- First release: upstream ANGLE, Metal backend, arm64
- libEGL + libGLESv2 under /var/jb/lib/angle
- EGL_ANGLE_iosurface_client_buffer validated on the A10 GPU
